notes.title: From Now On Edvog Explorer Game Will Be Under 1 Dollar On All Platforms
notes.notes: From now on you will be able to buy the game on Steam for under 1 Dollar or play for free on Google Play (Android Version) https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Edvog.Project At the date I published this announcement Edvog Explorer Game has been downloaded and played by over 300 people - I want to thank you all for buying Edvog Explorer Game.

notes.title: Edvog Explorer Game Is Now Available on Steam and Google Play (Android Version)
notes.notes: I'm glad that today the game was officially launch on Steam. I hope that everyone will enjoy this original game and have a good time playing it. If you want to check out the mobile version here is the link https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Edvog.Project
